This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is said to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Scleromitrion diffusum include its potential to act as an antimicrobial and antiviral agent, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system.
